threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still avoid the post-pub kebab shop on Kingsland Road like it's a tourist trap, while the rest of us know it's a rite of passage.
Saw a guy on the 59 last night trying to sell dodgy knock-off phone cases. The bus driver just rolled his eyes and kept driving.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a guy in a bunny costume handing out flyers for a vegan café while a street musician played Beethoven on a saxophone. Classic Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You know that feeling when your U-Bahn route suddenly changes, and you have to follow the crowds exiting for a surprise street festival? Classic Berlin.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local when they casually know the Muni schedule by heart but still carry a backup plan for BART's inevitable breakdowns.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy serenading passengers on a delayed 38 bus with a ukulele, seemingly unfazed by the chaos around him. Classic San Francisco moment!

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all the tapas here are authentic; they miss the tiny, family-run spots that serve the real deal, hidden in the back alleys.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newcomer by their confusion over how to order a café. It's always 'con leche' or just 'negro'—never just 'coffee'!

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think ordering coffee means a barista won’t judge you for asking for decaf. Just wait till you try the local roasts.
Saw a guy on the 77 last night arguing with his reflection in the window. Thought he was gonna start throwing punches at himself.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I heard a saxophonist jamming outside the Kottbusser Tor U-Bahn while a group of kids danced, I realized this place has a heartbeat like no other.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can get a currywurst with vegan sausage at almost every stand in Kreuzberg. Who knew meatless versions could taste so iconic?

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here if they can name the taco truck parked at 16th and Mission before it moves on. It's like a neighborhood secret menu.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 5-Fulton today, but it turned into a stand-up comedy show when the driver yelled at a passenger for trying to board with a parrot.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia’s only about the plazas, but it’s the little side streets with their hidden bars that reveal the heart of the neighborhood.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their heavy backpacks stuffed with maps – still looking puzzled at every corner, like they’re on a treasure hunt.
